tasks.request: Improve Korean multi-action task decomposition in src/engine/decompose.rs without hardcoding example sentences. Inspect actual source and implement a grounded patch that preserves numbered lists and single noun requests.

Improve ranked memory retrieval in src/engine/memory.rs across mixed Korean and English facts with distractors. Keep top-answer accuracy and existing owner provenance, reduce measurable retrieval cost where possible. Inspect current source and implement a real change.

Improve group-chat context construction efficiency without losing the owner instructions, participant personas, earlier assistant turns or memory facts. Inspect actual context-harness source and implement a verifiable code change.

Improve the source-improvement domain exploration algorithm in src/engine/rsi_evolve.rs without hardcoding a fixed answer sequence. Reduce actual search cost while preserving history-dependent exploration decisions and validated evidence.
